items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: Joe Corsello was one of them [drummers in the Goodman Sextet]

ctx.x: Who else was in the Goodman Sextet at that time?

Al Klink, Bucky Pizzarelli, John Bunch, Slam Stewart, various drummers, numerous drummers, Joe Corsello was one of them, and oh God, Mousey Alexander sometimes, and Connie Kay. Benny went through drummers like — going out of style.
Yeah? He was pretty particular about that wasn’t he?
